quarterly_data.quarter: FiberHome Telecommunication investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: to relieve cabling pressure from AI-cluster scale-up and scale-out, FiberHome launched the Fit MPO all-optical connectivity solution with miniaturized and multi-core connectors covering 8/12/16/24/32-core ferrules; versus traditional cabling, connector volume shrinks to 1/3, and multi-core MPO and multi-core cable raise cabinet cabling density by more than 12 times and free more than 70% of cabling-channel space, addressing space and heat-dissipation limits in high-density networks.
quarterly_data.figure: 8/12/16/24/32-core; connector volume 1/3; cabling density >12x; >70% channel space freed

quarterly_data.quarter: FiberHome Telecommunication investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: for all-optical interconnect in intelligent computing centers, FiberHome launched the Fengine 51.2T NPO switch and built around it an in-center all-optical interconnect solution covering scale-up and scale-out, which it says can give 'East Data West Computing' hub nodes and city intelligent computing centers a unified all-optical base (the answer stated no deployment).
